description: The WITH RESET phrase of NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (kb/Work PB5242). §1985:XIII.3.16.2 prints `NEXT GROUP IS {integer-1 | PLUS integer-2 | NEXT PAGE}`; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.35.1 adds `[WITH RESET]` and Annex F.2 item 115 lists "WITH RESET phrase added to NEXT PAGE". Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportNextGroupClause, once per written clause (VCR row 7.45 (f)).
display: the WITH RESET phrase of NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (report group description)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (f) - NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE WITH RESET (85->2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRNR.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRNR.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC 9(3) VALUE 5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1 NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE WITH RESET.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(3) VALUE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
